cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：巨大的
cards.example_en: We climbed the hills and saw a vast lake beyond them.
cards.example_zh: 我们爬上山丘，看见远处有一片很大的湖。

cards.example_en: The film has no violence, so younger children can watch it.
cards.example_zh: 这部电影没有暴力，所以更小的孩子也可以看。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：自愿的
cards.example_en: Joining the library club is voluntary this term.
cards.example_zh: 这学期参加图书馆社团是自愿的。

cards.example_en: Whenever it rains, we play cards in the living room.
cards.example_zh: 一下雨，我们就在客厅里打牌。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：无论哪里
cards.example_zh: 你喜欢坐哪儿就坐哪儿。

cards.example_en: Her disability means she uses a ramp instead of the front steps.
cards.example_zh: 她有残疾，所以走坡道，不走前门的台阶。

cards.example_en: The sun will disappear behind those hills at dusk.
cards.example_zh: 黄昏时，太阳会消失在那些山后面。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：失望的
cards.example_en: I was disappointed with my score.
cards.example_zh: 我对自己的分数感到失望。

cards.example_en: Extra income from weekend work pays for his art supplies.
cards.example_zh: 周末打工的额外收入用来买他的美术用品。

cards.example_en: Real interaction started when we swapped roles in the scene.
cards.example_zh: 我们在场景里交换角色后，真正的互动才开始。

cards.example_en: A recommendation from the coach got him onto the team.
cards.example_zh: 教练的推荐让他进了校队。

cards.example_en: We played the recording of our class choir at home.
cards.example_zh: 我们在家里播放了班级合唱团的录音。

cards.example_en: Two students represent our class at the city forum.
cards.example_zh: 两名学生在城市论坛上代表我们班。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：在……下面
cards.example_en: My football was underneath the bed after the game.
cards.example_zh: 比赛结束以后，我的足球在床底下。

cards.scene: 出行交通 · Travel and Transport
cards.example_en: Any movement in the bushes made the rabbits run away.
cards.example_zh: 灌木丛里只要有动静，兔子就跑开了。
